heading: top-split
name: 標題列右側箭頭＋方形圖片卡片輪播
desc: 上方一列標題靠左、左右箭頭靠右；下方是一次露出四張的卡片輪播，每張卡片上方是方形圖片，下方是文字區。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊上方放標題組：標題靠左，一組小型左右箭頭按鈕靠右，兩者在同一列垂直置中；標題組包含標題（可多行），沒有其他元素。標題明顯大於項目的標題。標題組下方是輪播，對齊頁面內容寬度，桌機一次露出四個項目、不露出下一個項目，用標題列右側的左右箭頭切換。每個項目是一張卡片，卡片下半部的文字區有自己的底色：上方是方形圖片，圖片貼齊卡片上緣與左右兩側；下方文字區保留內距，放標題（可多行），標題下方可放次要文字與一段較醒目的短文字，沒有時省略。所有項目等寬、圖片同一比例，同一排的卡片等高，標題長短不同時卡片底緣仍對齊。
tablet: 平板沿用桌機版，一次露出的項目數量減少。
mobile: 輪播改為橫向滑動，邊緣露出下一個項目的一部分：一次露出約兩個項目，靠左對齊頁面內容寬度，右側露出下一個項目的一部分，延伸到畫面右緣。卡片組成不變，同一排的卡片仍等高。標題組維持標題靠左、左右箭頭靠右在同一列。可用手指左右滑動切換。

en.name: Heading row with right-side arrows + square-image card carousel
en.desc: A top row with the title on the left and left/right arrows on the right; below it is a card carousel showing four cards at a time, each with a square image on top and a text area below.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. Place the heading group at the top, with the title on the left and a set of small left and right arrow buttons on the right, both vertically centered on the same row; the heading group contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines) and no other elements. The title is noticeably larger than the item titles. Below the heading group is a carousel aligned to the page content width; on desktop it shows four items at a time without revealing the next item, and is switched with the left and right arrows in the heading row. Each item is a card whose lower text area has its own background color: at the top is a square image, flush with the top edge and both sides of the card; the text area below keeps inner padding and holds a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally followed by secondary text and a short, more prominent piece of text; omit them when there is no content. All items are equal in width with images of the same ratio, and cards in the same row are equal in height, so their bottom edges stay aligned even when titles differ in length.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout, with fewer items visible at a time.
en.mobile: The carousel becomes horizontally swipeable, with part of the next item showing at the edge: about two items are visible at a time, aligned left with the page content width, while part of the next item shows on the right, extending to the right edge of the screen. The composition of each card stays the same, and cards in the same row remain equal in height. The heading group keeps the title on the left and the left and right arrows on the right on the same row. Items can be switched by swiping left and right.
